title: Manifold Sampling via Entropy Maximization
abstract: arXiv:2605.12338v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Sampling from constrained distributions has a wide range of applications, including in Bayesian optimization and robotics. Prior work establishes convergence and feasibility guarantees for constrained sampling, but assumes that the feasible set is connected. However, in practice, the feasible set often decomposes into multiple disconnected components, which makes efficient sampling under constraints challenging. In this paper, we propose MAnifold Sampling via Entropy Maximization (MASEM) for uniform sampling on a manifold with an unknown number of disconnected components, implicitly defined by smooth equality and inequality constraints. The presented method uses a resampling scheme to maximize the entropy of the empirical distribution based on k-nearest neighbor density estimation. translated_title: 通过熵最大化的流形采样
translated_abstract: 从受约束分布中采样具有广泛的应用，包括贝叶斯优化和机器人学等领域。先前的工作为受约束采样建立了收敛性和可行性保证，但假设可行集是连通的。然而，在实践中，可行集往往分解为多个不连通的分量，这使得在约束条件下进行高效采样变得具有挑战性。本文提出了通过熵最大化的流形采样方法（MASEM），用于在由光滑等式和不等式约束隐式定义、且不连通分量数量未知的流形上进行均匀采样。该方法采用重采样方案，基于 k 近邻密度估计来最大化经验分布的熵。我们证明，在平均场意义下，MASEM 使经验分布与最大熵目标分布之间的 KL 散度呈指数级下降……
tldr: 本文提出基于熵最大化的流形采样方法 MASEM，能够在光滑约束隐式定义、且被分割成未知数量不连通分量的可行域上实现均匀采样，并证明其在平均场意义下以指数速率收敛到最大熵目标分布。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MASEM, an entropy-maximization-based manifold sampling method that achieves uniform sampling on manifolds implicitly defined by smooth constraints with an unknown number of disconnected components, and proves exponential convergence in the mean field to the maximum-entropy target distribution.
